subject: E-2259: upload stalls on Windows
body:
Hi, I'm using LedgerLine 9.1.2 on Windows 11 24H2. Whenever I start a sync since
last week, the app shows "E-2259: upload stalled at 0 bytes/s".

This started right after the app updated itself on Tuesday. Before the update
the same files synced within minutes.

Before writing in I tried logging out of my browser; same error afterwards.

Regards, Luca Moretti, Meridian Schools
